scope_note: Agent evidence review 2026-10-20 inspected fresh main, recent changes, AGENTS, task/claims, lowest coverage, canonical/exported profiles, issue source/media and receipt schemas, exporter, release/quality validators, scripts, regression tests and CI before editing. Changed regression failed on old access metadata, then 33 focused tests passed. Candidate leakage passed. Five supplemental artifact/evaluator self-tests passed. All 68 local commands passed: 62 package validators, type check, 294 app tests, build, 103 Python tests, artifact verifier and diff check. Checks cover JSON/JSONL/CSV agreement, schemas, URL syntax, identifiers, duplicates, labels, source identity and source-to-claim links. Final receipt-inclusive full run and all exact-head hosted checks including locally unavailable PHP lint required before squash with fresh main/head/tree checks. Fresh-verification skill guided evidence-before-publication gates. Operational claim excluded from commits and released after merge; unrelated changes preserved. Agent evidence review is not actual human/expert/laboratory review. No actual training, inference or production deployment. Remaining gaps: experimentally resolved field epidemiology, linked residue/source sampling, calibrated same-leaf progression, sample-linked species confirmation and reusable diagnostic video. Symptom-only, culture-unlinked, single-locus, mixed-pathogen and rights-unclear samples retain human-review restrictions.
